g.text: Local tables show full columns. Orange boxes are cross-domain references defined in another slice.

g.title: PK: id Unique: uq_portal_storage_space_metadata_account_bucket(account_id, bucket_name) Check: ck_portal_storage_space_metadata_account_member_role: account_member_role IS NULL OR account_member_role IN ('Viewer', 'Editor'); ck_portal_storage_space_metadata_private_owner: (visibility = 'private' AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (visibility = 'shared' AND owner_user_id IS NULL); ck_portal_storage_space_metadata_share_scope: share_scope IN ('restricted', 'account') Indexes: ix_portal_storage_space_metadata_account(account_id) [index]; ix_portal_storage_space_metadata_id(id) [index]; ix_portal_storage_space_metadata_owner_user(owner_user_id) [index]

PK: id Unique: uq_portal_storage_space_grants_space_user(storage_space_metadata_id, user_id) Check: ck_portal_storage_space_grants_role: role IN ('Viewer', 'Editor') Indexes: ix_portal_storage_space_grants_id(id) [index]; ix_portal_storage_space_grants_space(storage_space_metadata_id) [index]; ix_portal_storage_space_grants_user(user_id) [index]

PK: id Unique: uq_portal_public_links_token(token) Indexes: ix_portal_public_links_account_bucket(account_id, bucket_name) [index]; ix_portal_public_links_expires(expires_at) [index]; ix_portal_public_links_id(id) [index]
